description: Copy Google data into Vault (copy only, nothing is deleted at Google). source gmail (labels or all mail, optional since/until), drive (fileIds picked in the portal) or google_photos (sessionIds of picking rounds from oma_storage_import_photos_pick, done when oma_storage_import_photos_poll says mediaItemsSet; lands in <folder>/<yyyy>/<yyyy-mm>) needs a connectionId from oma_storage_import_list (required when more than one account of that kind is connected; each account gets its own default folder); takeout needs the objectId of an uploaded Takeout zip. Returns a proposal; apply with oma_confirm_tool. Returns a proposal + confirmToken; call oma_confirm_tool next.

connectionId.description: Connected Google account from oma_storage_import_list (gmail, drive, google_photos).

destinationPath.description: Vault folder, empty for the root.

fileIds.description: Drive: ids picked in the portal.

objectId.description: Takeout: the uploaded zip in Vault.

sessionIds.description: Google Photos: picking rounds from oma.storage.import_photos_pick.

source.description: What to copy into Vault (copy only).

name: oma_storage_import_start
title: Copy Google data into Vault
